_meta.description: Product-intent confirmation record for the three submitted links, per the owner's 2026-11-17 directive: for each submitted link, store the intended ASIN, the official listing URL, the confirmation date and the source. Observed redirect targets are kept in a separate field and are never merged with the intended values - the intended ASIN is what the owner selected (and what the resolved page confirms); the observed redirect target is what the short link actually served on a given date, with whatever parameters it carried.
_meta.field_rule: intended_asin and official_listing_url come from the confirmed product identity and never change without an owner decision (D-13 stays the owner's). observed_redirect_targets is an append-only observation log: each entry dates one read, names the target actually served and whether an Associates tag was visible, and cites the session record it comes from. No field of the second kind is ever copied into the first.
_meta.asin_definition_source: Amazon's official ASIN definition (sell.amazon.com): a unique 10-character alphanumeric code, typically beginning with B0 - the checkable identifier the intended-ASIN field is validated against.
_meta.confirmation_rule: confirmation_date_utc is the most recent dated read on which the submitted link resolved to the intended ASIN with matching listing title and category breadcrumb. All three confirmations were re-performed on 2026-11-17 (data/verification-session-1f4a7a22.json).
